Protests showed no sign of easing, with more than 500 schools closed a day ‌after demonstrations swept across the country, and unions representing high-school students, teachers and other workers planning more marches for October 8.

author: Reuters
description:
Protesters camp in Madrid demanding political action to stop evictions and address Spain's housing crisis. The 87-year-old Spanish woman, Maricarmen Abascal, whose dramatic eviction last month sparked mass housing protests that led to an early election announcement, died on October 8. Thousands demonstrated over her death.
